# `pygeovision zoo`

The **AI Model Zoo**: a metadata catalogue of about 96 architectures with size, task, licence and tags. It describes
models; it does not build them (use [`models`](models.md) for that).

## When to use it

Use it to explore what exists for a task or sensor.

## What you get

Tables from `list`, `search`, `top`, `stats`; `info` shows the full record.

## Things to know

A zoo entry is not necessarily buildable in PyGeoVision. Check [the model catalogue](../../models/catalog.md) for the build status.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision zoo [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Browse the AI Model Zoo, a metadata catalogue of about 96 architectures (it describes models;
  it does not build them).

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  info    Show full metadata for a model.
  list    List models from the AI Model Zoo.
  search  Search the model zoo by name, architecture, or tag.
  stats   Show model zoo statistics.
  top     Show the top-N models for a task.
```

| Argument | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | yes |

### `pygeovision zoo list`

List models from the AI Model Zoo.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task` | text |  |  | Filter by task (segmentation, detection, …). |
| `--tag` | text |  |  | Filter by tag (transformer, real_time, sar, …). |
| `--max-params` | number |  |  | Max parameters in millions. |
| `--hf-only` | flag | off |  | Only models with HuggingFace weights. |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision zoo list [OPTIONS]

  List models from the AI Model Zoo.

Options:
  --task TEXT         Filter by task (segmentation, detection, …).
  --tag TEXT          Filter by tag (transformer, real_time, sar, …).
  --max-params FLOAT  Max parameters in millions.
  --hf-only           Only models with HuggingFace weights.
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
:::
